name: Click Window Scanner
description: After a bot completes a level, replays it and finds how many frames of leeway each click has.

enabled.name: Show Window Counter
enabled.description: Toggle the counter on or off.

show-popup.name: Show Click Popups
show-popup.description: Show the window size next to the player on every click after a scan.

range.name: Scan Range (frames)
range.description: How many frames earlier and later each click is tested. Bigger is slower.

tps.name: Physics Steps Per Second
tps.description: Must match the TPS your bot uses. <cy>240</c> is the game default.

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.description: Opacity of the text (0 = invisible, 255 = solid).
